name: io.github.Ethereal49/diynow
title: DIYNow
description: Official-source facts on master's programmes for 2027 entry: HK, Macau, SG, UK, AU and more.

tools.name: get_coverage
tools.description: What DIYNow covers right now: regions, schools and programme counts, and how many programmes have collected facts (the rest are directory entries with only a name and an official link). Use it to check whether a region or school is covered at all, for example when a search finds nothing.

tools.name: search_programmes
tools.description: Search master's programmes for 2027 entry. Returns ids, names, school, and short duration / tuition / language summaries with their year status. Confirmed numeric matches come first; within each group: 2027 summaries, other collected facts, then directory-only entries. Text query matches Chinese or English programme names, subjects, school names and common synonyms.

query.description: Programme, subject or school words, e.g. "商业分析" or "data science HKU"; at most 6 words

school.description: School id or name, e.g. "HKU", "UK-EDINBURGH", "爱丁堡大学". A school DIYNow does not cover is reported as an error

subject.description: One of the subject groups returned in results, e.g. "计算机与数据"

kind.description: standalone_project: a mainland Chinese-foreign cooperative programme

maxTuition.description: Whole-programme tuition ceiling in `currency`; only fees confirmed for 2027 count as matching

currency.description: Currency of maxTuition. Default: the region's currency (GBP for UK), or HKD without a region. Fees in another currency do not match; nothing is converted

maxIelts.description: The applicant's IELTS overall; keeps programmes whose confirmed 2027 requirement is not higher

includeUnconfirmed.description: With maxTuition / maxIelts: also list programmes whose value is not confirmed for 2027 (default true)

tools.name: get_programme
tools.description: Every collected fact for one programme: admission requirements, language, tests, documents, deadlines, tuition, curriculum and more. Each fact has its value, official quote when available, source links and yearStatus ("confirmed_2027", "2026 年资料", "undated" or "school_policy"). University, faculty and department rules are listed separately in schoolRules, each with its scope (university_policy, faculty_policy or department_policy). A missing field means not collected, not "no requirement".

fields.description: Optional subset of field keys, e.g. ["language","documents","deadlines"]

tools.name: check_requirements
tools.description: Compare an applicant's numbers with the published hard requirements of one programme (`id`) or a whole shortlist (`ids`): IELTS overall and sub-score, whole-programme tuition against a budget. Each check returns met / not_met / unknown with the official wording and whether the requirement is confirmed for 2027. Academic background, GPA, tests, experience and documents are not checked; they are returned as official text. The tool never estimates admission chances.

ids.description: Up to 10 programmes per call; the answer is { results: [...] }

tools.name: get_deadlines
tools.description: Application deadlines for up to 10 programmes at once, soonest first. Only dates the official page gives for the 2027 intake are counted; programmes without such dates are listed as unknown with any other deadline text found, or else the university or faculty rule (yearStatus school_policy, with its scope). Day counts run from today's date where each school is.

tools.name: get_school
tools.description: One school: Chinese and official names, region, overview, reviewed world rankings (provider and edition named) and its programme count.
